title: Static Skill Quality Rubric

scoring_scale.label: Missing / unsafe
scoring_scale.definition: Absent, contradictory, or too vague to apply; creates material risk.

scoring_scale.label: Partial
scoring_scale.definition: Present but ambiguous, incomplete, or not consistently testable.

scoring_scale.label: Clear / testable
scoring_scale.definition: Explicit, internally consistent, proportionate, and usable by the target runtime.

hard_fail_conditions: Destructive, production, external, or permission-changing actions without appropriate authorization.
Invented tool access, runtime capabilities, evidence, or test results.
Conflict with repository-wide authority or silent override of a higher-priority workflow.
Exposure of secrets or sensitive personal data.
Material unsafe or misleading false-positive trigger with no mitigating stop condition.

criteria.title: Trigger and scope boundary
criteria.description: Explicit intended triggers and important non-triggers reduce false-positive routing.

criteria.title: Inputs and prerequisites
criteria.description: Required context, assumptions, tools, access, and approval prerequisites are explicit.

criteria.title: Procedure executability
criteria.description: Ordered actionable steps, decision points, and observable evidence expectations.

criteria.title: Output contract
criteria.description: Concrete output contract with verifiable required fields or artifacts.

criteria.title: Safety and failure handling
criteria.description: Scope, stop conditions, uncertainty, and unavailable-tool behavior are explicit and safe.

criteria.title: Evaluation coverage and evidence
criteria.description: At least 3 in-scope, 2 near-miss, and 1 edge case; expected and prohibited behaviors are measurable.
